This role provides financial support for the FP&A Tech Strategy Finance team, including developing methodologies and processes that bring transparency to financial results, analyzing current financial results to identify and address evolving business issues and opportunities, and supporting [Company name masked]'s Tech function as they plan for new initiatives.
The role requires strong communication, problem solving, ability to collaborate cross-functionally, and strong influencing skills in order to effectively:
Articulate outcomes of analysis and relevant insights, connect regularly with business leadership to assess the financial implications of various initiatives, and develop presentations to communicate business and analysis results to senior leadership audiences.
cond_0384.responsibilities:
Financial analysis & reporting: Accurately analyze & explain key drivers and manage the regular reporting process
Budgeting, forecasting, and Profit & Loss (P&L) management
Executive business presentations: Actively contribute to the development of presentations to communicate analysis results to senior audiences; clearly articulate outcomes of analysis and walk leadership teams through key findings
Ad-hoc requests on acquisition related topics
Independently manage, prioritize, and delegate tasks
Act as project lead for certain responsibilities on the team
cond_0384.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's Degree or military experience
At least 4 years experience in financial analysis
At least 4 years experience with financial modeling
At least 1 year of experience managing a Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) function
Preferred Requirements:
Master's Degree in Business Administration (MBA) or Master's Degree in Finance, Economics or Accounting
Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) license or Certified Public Accountant (CPA) license
At least 6 years of experience in financial analysis
At least 6 years of experience with financial modeling
At least 3 years of experience managing a Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) function
At this time, [Company name masked] will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position.
No agencies please.

This role supports the FP&A Tech Strategy Finance team, including developing methodologies and processes that provide transparency to financial results, working with others to analyze current financial results, and helping [Company name masked]'s Tech function plan for new initiatives.
The role requires strong communication, problem solving, ability to collaborate cross-functionally, and strong influencing skills in order to effectively:
Clarify outcomes of analysis and share relevant insights with stakeholders. Partner with business leadership to assess the financial implications of various initiatives. Coordinate on presentations to communicate business and analysis results to senior leadership audiences.
cond_0414.responsibilities: Financial analysis & reporting: Work with the team to accurately analyze and explain key drivers and support the regular reporting process. Coordinate on budgeting, forecasting, and Profit & Loss (P&L) management. Executive business presentations: Help develop presentations to communicate analysis results to senior audiences; share outcomes of analysis clearly with leadership teams. Collaborate on ad-hoc requests on acquisition related topics. Help manage, prioritize, and delegate tasks across the team. Serve as project coordinator for certain responsibilities on the team.
cond_0414.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree or military experience
At least 4 years experience in financial analysis
At least 4 years experience with financial modeling
At least 1 year of experience managing a Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) function
Master's Degree in Business Administration (MBA) or Master's Degree in Finance, Economics or Accounting
Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) license or Certified Public Accountant (CPA) license
At least 6 years of experience in financial analysis
At least 6 years of experience with financial modeling
At least 3 years of experience managing a Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) function
At this time, [Company name masked] will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position.
No agencies please.

The role requires strong communication, problem solving, ability to coordinate cross-functionally, and strong influencing skills in order to effectively:
Document outcomes of analysis and relevant insights, coordinate with business leadership to assess the financial implications of various initiatives, and prepare presentations to share business and analysis results with senior leadership.
cond_0637.responsibilities:
Financial analysis & reporting: Accurately analyze and explain key drivers and manage the reporting process
Budgeting, forecasting, and Profit & Loss (P&L) management
Executive business presentations: Assist in development of presentations to share analysis results with senior audiences; clearly document outcomes of analysis for leadership teams
Ad-hoc requests on acquisition related topics
Independently manage, prioritize, and delegate tasks
Act as project lead for certain responsibilities on the team
cond_0637.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's Degree or military experience
At least 4 years experience in financial analysis
At least 4 years experience with financial modeling
At least 1 year of experience managing a Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) function
Preferred Requirements:
Master's Degree in Business Administration (MBA) or Master's Degree in Finance, Economics or Accounting
Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) license or Certified Public Accountant (CPA) license
At least 6 years of experience in financial analysis
At least 6 years of experience with financial modeling
At least 3 years of experience managing a Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) function
